class.name: RailVehicleLoad
class.brief_description: A class that manages cargo loading and unloading operations for train cars.
class.description:
RailVehicleLoad class handles the loading and unloading operations for train cars. It provides functionality to manage cargo transfer speeds, load capacity, and different types of cargo units (tons or pieces). The class includes overload protection and supports various loading configurations through a list of load items.
Example usage: [codeblock] var train_load = RailVehicleLoad.new() train_load.max_load = 50.0 train_load.load_unit = RailVehicleLoad.LOAD_UNIT_TONS train_load.load_speed = 2.0 train_load.current_load = 25.0 # Load 25 tons of cargo [/codeblock]

method.name: get_load_amount
method.description: How much the vehicle carries now.

method.name: get_load_exchange_speed
method.description: How many doors are open at the platform's side of the exchange - 0 while none is, and the exchange waits ([code]LoadExchangeSpeed()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2855[/code]).

method.name: get_load_exchange_time
method.description: The seconds the exchange still takes: what is still to get off at [member unload_speed] and to get on at [member load_speed], through the doors open at the platform - or, while none is, as fast as its side allows ([code]LoadExchangeTime()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2843[/code]). 0 when there is nothing to exchange.

method.name: get_load_name
method.description: What the vehicle carries, empty for nothing.

method.name: load_add
method.description: So much more to get on at the platform's [param side], in the vehicle's own frame. An empty vehicle takes [param load_name] first, or the first load it accepts for an empty name ([code]station.cpp:49-54[/code]). Standing, the vehicle opens its doors at that side and takes a second's worth per open door; faster than 2 km/h it gives the exchange up; once done, passengers may close the doors they control ([code]TDynamicObject::update_exchange()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2872-2960[/code]).

method.name: load_remove
method.description: So much more to get off at the platform's [param side], in the vehicle's own frame, before anything gets on; an emptied vehicle carries nothing ([code]TDynamicObject::LoadExchange()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2813[/code]).

members.member: Type of cargo (pantstate — start with the pantograph raised on the electric locomotive).

Rate at which cargo can be unloaded per second.

signal.name: load_exchange_finished
signal.description: The exchange at a platform is over: everything got off and on, or the vehicle moved off and gave it up. Emitted once per exchange.
